tool_input.description: List card divs in both snapshots

result:
I wrote the test, and it passes on the before snapshot and fails on the after snapshot as intended. On the after snapshot it fails with: `html:nth-child(1) > body:nth-child(2) > section:nth-child(3) > div:nth-child(2) background-color: expected rgb(220, 252, 231), got rgb(254, 202, 202)`.

The test finds the Savings Accounts card at that selector and checks that its heading reads "Savings Accounts". It then asserts the card's `background-color` is still the before snapshot's green `rgb(220, 252, 231)` (`#dcfce7`), which the diff changed to pink `#fecaca`.

The only thing it checks is this one card's background. It skips the intended changes: the removed About link, the bigger heading, the added list item and the taller footer.

My shell command to print the card's selector and color from the snapshots was blocked. So I worked out the selector from the element order in `before.html` and the way `parse.py` builds selectors. I confirmed the green value is in the before snapshot by searching the file. The two test runs above confirm both.
